summary: Frontend-only testing of the NEW Kasir additions on /admin. All items verified end-to-end via Playwright against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: (1) Kode Barang auto-fills from letters (YVK) when opening Barang Terjual and remains fully editable (typed 'YVK-EDIT-1' successfully). (2) PhotoUpload for Foto Produk and Bukti Transfer both present; uploads via hidden file input succeed against real /api/admin/upload (object storage), remove buttons appear after upload. (3) Saved sale switches to Riwayat and shows both thumbnails (cashier-thumb-produk-<id>, cashier-thumb-transfer-<id>); clicking opens the lightbox (cashier-image-preview). (4) 'Bagikan ke WhatsApp' button per row triggers window.open with a wa.me URL whose decoded text includes item name and 'Harga: Rp 1.350.000'. (5) Harga ke Pembeli modal overlay has computed backgroundColor rgb(0,0,0) (solid black, tailwind bg-black) as required. (6) Cleanup via cashier-delete-sale-<id> + cashier-confirm-delete removed the TEST_ sale.
critical_code_review_comments: CashierPanel.jsx now ~510 lines with calculator, sell form, riwayat, buyer modal, lightbox and PhotoUpload — consider splitting into subcomponents (SellForm, SalesHistory, BuyerModal) for maintainability.

shareWA embeds foto_produk / bukti_transfer full image URLs in the WhatsApp text; for privacy/UX, consider making inclusion of the bukti_transfer link optional (a checkbox) since it's a payment receipt.

Buyer modal overlay uses fully opaque bg-black which fully hides page context (per spec); ensure this is intended for all use cases — no way to see the cashier UI behind while showing to buyer (which is likely the desired 'privacy' behavior).
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up one TEST_ sale via UI (TEST_Sepeda_UI3 / TEST_Pembeli3 / kode YVK-EDIT-1) with real uploaded foto_produk and bukti_transfer PNGs to object storage. Sale deleted at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New Kasir additions (photo uploads, thumbnails+lightbox, WhatsApp share, kode_barang autofill+editable, dark buyer modal) all verified on 2026-01. Object storage upload endpoint (/api/admin/upload) works from the sell form; wa.me share opens with encoded text containing nama_barang and Harga. If retesting, drive via: admin-tab-kasir -> cashier-key-Y/V/K -> cashier-check-jual -> cashier-open-sell -> sell-foto-produk/sell-bukti-transfer file inputs -> sell-save; then cashier-share-sale-<id> (stub window.open to capture URL) and cashier-thumb-produk-<id> for lightbox.
